name: Duelists of Tomorrow Speed Duel Deck
cleanName: Duelists of Tomorrow Speed Duel Deck
extDescription:
Destiny Masters Speed Duel Deck contains:
• 1 20-Card Seto Kaiba Deck
• 1 20-Card Mai Valentine Deck
• 1 23-Card Joey Wheeler Deck
• 9 Skill Cards (3 for Kaiba, 3 for Mai and 3 for Joey)
• 3 Ultra Rare variant cards

name: Peak Performance
extDescription: All Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Beatdown!
extDescription:
If you control a Level 5 or higher monster, you can activate this Skill.
All monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK for each Level 5 or higher monster you control. At the end of your turn, flip this card over.

name: Dragon Caller
extDescription:
Once per Duel, you can use 1 of the following Skills.
• If you successfully Normal Summon "Lord of D.", add 1 "The Flute of Summoning Dragon" from your Deck or GY to your hand.
• Reveal "The Flute of Summoning Dragon" from your hand, then add 1 "Lord of D." from your Deck or GY to your hand.

name: Grit
extDescription: At the start of your turn, call 2 numbers and roll a six-sided die. If you roll a number you called, your LP do not get lower than 1 until the end of your opponent's next turn. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

name: Last Gamble
extDescription:
At the start of the 5th turn, activate this Skill (count both players' turns).
During your Main Phase, you can reduce your LP to 100 and discard 2 cards from your hand. Roll a six-sided die and draw cards equal to the result. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

name: Pal-O'Mine-zation!
extDescription: During your turn, you may reveal 1 Normal Monster in your hand. This turn, that monster can substitute for any 1 Fusion Material. If you do, the other Fusion Material(s) must be the correct one(s). This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

name: Aroma Strategy
extDescription: You may look at the top card of your Deck at any time.

name: Flight of the Harpies
extDescription:
If you lose 1800 or more LP, you can activate this Skill during your next Draw Phase.
During your Draw Phase, you may search your Deck for a "Harpie" card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand instead of drawing. If you do that, flip this card over.

name: Tribal Synergy
extDescription:
If you have an "Amazoness" monster and a "Harpie" monster in your hand, reveal them and draw 1 card.
If you control an "Amazoness" monster and a "Harpie" monster, draw 2 cards.
Each of these Skills can only be used once per Duel.

name: Champion's Vigilance
extDescription: If you control a Level 7 or higher Normal Monster, when a monster would be summoned OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

name: Fusion Gate
extDescription: While this card is on the field: The turn player can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from their Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from their hand or field.

name: Amazoness Village
extDescription: All "Amazoness" monsters gain 200 ATK . Once per turn, When an "Amazoness" monster is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY : You can Special Summon 1 "Amazoness" monster from your Deck with a Level less than or equal to that "Amazoness" monster in the GY.

name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
extDescription: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

name: Battle Ox
extDescription: A monster with tremendous power, it destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

name: Ryu-Kishin Powered
extDescription: A gargoyle enhanced by the powers of darkness. Very sharp talons make it a worthy opponent.

name: Luster Dragon #2
extDescription: This dragon feeds on emerald. Enchanted by this monster even when attacked , few people live to tell of its beauty.

name: Lord of D.
extDescription: Dragon-Type monsters on the field cannot be targeted by card effects.

name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
extDescription: During the End Phase, if this card is in the Graveyard because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK and DEF becomes 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

name: Tyrant Dragon
extDescription: During your Battle Phase, if your opponent controls a monster after this card's first attack, this card can make a second attack. Negate any Trap effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card. This card cannot be Special Summoned from the GY, unless you Tribute 1 Dragon-Type monster.

name: Spirit Ryu
extDescription: You can only activate this effect during your Battle Step, if this card battles during your turn. Discard 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand to the GY to increase the ATK and DEF of this card by 1000 points until the End Step.

name: Kaibaman
extDescription: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand.

name: The Flute of Summoning Dragon
extDescription: Special Summon up to 2 Dragon monsters from your hand. "Lord of D." must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Stamping Destruction
extDescription: If you control a Dragon-Type monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.

name: Cost Down
extDescription: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

name: Burst Stream of Destruction
extDescription: If you control "Blue Eyes White Dragon": Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control can not attack the turn you activate this card.

name: Mountain
extDescription: Increase the ATK and DEF of all Dragon, Winged Beast, and Thunder-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish that target until the End Phase .

name: Dragon's Rebirth
extDescription: Target 1 Dragon-Type monster you control; banish that target, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand or GY.

name: Trap Jammer
extDescription: When your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Red-Eyes B. Dragon
extDescription: A ferocious dragon with a deadly attack.

name: Meteor Dragon
extDescription: This dragon appeared from the sky and crashed to the earth.

name: Flame Manipulator
extDescription: This Spellcaster attacks enemies with fire-related spells such as "Sea of Flames" and "Wall of Fire".

name: Masaki the Legendary Swordsman
extDescription: Legendary swordmaster Masaki is a veteran of over 100 battles.

name: Alligator's Sword
extDescription: 'ey, dis mighty lissard man can swing his sword so fast, dat it's more dan da speed a sound!

name: Baby Dragon
extDescription: Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

name: Time Wizard
extDescription: Once per turn: You can to coin and call it. If you call it right, destroy all monsters your opponent controls. If you call it wrong, destroy it as much as possible, and if you do, take damage equal to half the total ATK those destroyed monsters had on the field.

name: Little-Winguard
extDescription: Once per turn, during your End Phase: You can change the battle position of this card.

name: Copycat
extDescription: When this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; this card's ATK and DEF become equal to that monster's original ATK and DEF.

name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
extDescription: When an Equip Card(s) is equipped to this card: Destroy that Equip Card(s).

name: Polymerization
extDescription: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material.

name: Stray Lambs
extDescription: Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

name: Legendary Sword
extDescription: A Warrior-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Sogen
extDescription: Increases the ATK and DEF of all Beast-Warrior and Warrior-Type monsters by 200 points.

name: Dicephoon
extDescription:
Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
• 2, 3, or 4: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field.
• 5: Destroy 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field.
• 1 or 6: You take 1000 damage.

name: Graceful Dice
extDescription: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters you currently control gain ATK and DEF equal to the result x 100, until the End Phase.

name: Skull Dice
extDescription: Roll a six-sided die. All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK and DEF equal to the result x 100, until the End Phase.

name: Kunai with Chain
extDescription:
Activate 1 or both of these effects (simultaneously).
• When an opponent's monster declares an attack : Target the attacking monster; change that target to Defense Position.
• Target 1 face-up monster you control ; equip this card To That target. It gains 500 ATK.

name: Red-Eyes Spirit
extDescription: Target 1 "Red-Eyes" monster in your GY, except "Red-Eyes B. Chick"; Special Summon it.

name: Flame Swordsman
extDescription: "Flame Manipulator" + "Masaki the Legendary Swordsman"

name: Thousand Dragon
extDescription: "Time Wizard" + "Baby Dragon"

name: Alligator's Sword Dragon
extDescription:
"Baby Dragon" + "Alligator's Sword"
This card can attack your opponent directly if the only face-up monsters they control are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE.

name: Harpie Lady 1
extDescription:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
All WIND monsters gain 300 ATK.

name: Harpie Lady 2
extDescription:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
Negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters this card destroys by battle.

name: Harpie Lady 3
extDescription:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
An opponent's monster that battles this card cannot declare an attack during your opponent's next 2 turns.

name: Harpie Lady Sisters
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned with "Elegant Egotist".

name: Amazoness Chain Master
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can pay 1500 Life Points; look at your opponent's hand, then add 1 monster from their hand to your hand.

name: Amazoness Swords Woman
extDescription: Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card instead.

name: Amazoness Sage
extDescription: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card atacked and is still on the field: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

name: Birdface
extDescription: When this card is sent to the GY as a result of battle, you can add 1 "Harpie Lady" from your Deck to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Sonic Shooter
extDescription: If there are no cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. When it does, any Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent's Life Points becomes the original ATK of this card.

name: Elegant Egotist
extDescription: If "Harpie Lady" is on the field: Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sistesr" from your hand or Deck.

name: Triangle Ecstasy Spark
extDescription: Until the end of this turn, the ATK of all "Harpie Lady SIsters" currently on the field becomes 2700, your opponent cannot activate any Trap Cards, also negate all of your opponent's Trap effects on the field.

name: Cyber Shield
extDescription: Equip only to "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters". It gains 500 ATK.

name: Harpies' Hunting Ground
extDescription: All Winged Beast monsters gain 200 ATK/DEF. If any "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" is Normal or Special Summoned: The player who conducted the Summon targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field; that player destroys that target.

name: Amazoness Heirloom
extDescription: Equip only to an "Amazoness" monster. Once per turn, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle. When the equipped monster attacks, after damage calculation, destroy the attack target.

name: Amazoness Archers
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent declares an attack while you control an "Amazoness" monster. All monsters your opponent controls are changed to face-up Attack Position (Flip Effects are not activated), and lose 500 ATK as long as they remain face-up on the field. Your opponent must attack with all of their monsters.

name: Windstorm of Etaqua
extDescription: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

name: Shadow of Eyes
extDescription: When a monster(s) is Set on your opponent's side of the field: Target 1 of those Set monsters; change that Set monster to face-up Attack Position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

name: Wild Tornado
extDescription: Target 1 face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone; destroy that face-up card, then, its controller can Set 1 Spell or Trap from their hand. If this Set card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy that target.
